summary: Russian forces are reported by Russian MoD to be completing the liberation of Krasny Lyman with organized Ukrainian defense broken. Ukraine launched one of the largest ballistic missile attacks on Kyiv of the full-scale war with over 32 rockets fired. Multiple drone and missile threats were tracked across Sumy, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, Chernihiv, Kharkiv and other regions.
key_points: VSRF are completing the liberation of Krasny Lyman with organized VSU defense broken and isolated pockets destroyed, Gerasimov reported (Source: @tass_agency/385901).
Over 32 rockets were launched at Kyiv in what may be among the largest ballistic attacks of the full-scale war (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69173).
Ukraine struck two major logistics objects in Moscow and Tambov regions over 500 and about 700 km from the front (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).
A drone was tracked in Shostka district of Sumy region heading south (Source: @kpszsu/69067).
A reactive drone was reported heading toward Zaporizhzhia from the southeast (Source: @kpszsu/69063).
Two reactive drones were reported over Zaporizhzhia airport and Kosmichny from the east (Source: @eRadarrua/101548).
A drone was tracked from the Black Sea toward Vesela Balka in Odesa region (Source: @kpszsu/69034).
Russian MoD released footage of Geran-4 Shikher and Gerbera-Shikher drone attack on a Black Sea container ship with military cargo (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31722).

sections.executive_summary: Russian forces are reported by the Russian MoD to be completing the liberation of Krasny Lyman with organized Ukrainian defense broken. Ukraine conducted one of the largest ballistic missile barrages on Kyiv of the full-scale war with over 32 rockets launched. Widespread drone and missile threats were tracked across Sumy, Zaporizhzhia, Odesa, Chernihiv, Kharkiv and other Ukrainian regions alongside Ukrainian deep strikes into Russia.

points: Over 32 rockets were launched at Kyiv in what monitor UA described as possibly the largest ballistic attack on the capital of the full-scale war, with multiple ballistic missiles tracked from Kursk and via Lubny (Source: @mon1tor_ua/69173, @mon1tor_ua/69179, @mon1tor_ua/69142, @mon1tor_ua/69166, @mon1tor_ua/69167, @mon1tor_ua/69170).

A reactive drone was tracked from the Black Sea toward Vesela Balka in Odesa region and additional reactive drone groups were reported heading toward Odesa/Chornomorske from the Black Sea (Source: @kpszsu/69034, @kpszsu/69059, @kpszsu/69054, @kpszsu/69025, @eRadarrua/101552, @eRadarrua/101529).
Russia double-struck a locomotive and passenger cars on a train in Zaporizhzhia; all passengers and staff were moved to safety with no casualties reported (Source: @UkraineNow/82744).
A foreign-flagged commercial vessel was attacked on Odesa region with one dead and three wounded; a repeat Russian strike damaged rescue equipment during response (Source: @UkraineNow/82743).
A reactive drone was tracked in Chuhuiv district of Kharkiv region heading southeast and another toward Barvinkove in Kharkiv region (Source: @kpszsu/69036, @kpszsu/69072).
A drone was tracked in Shostka district of Sumy region heading south and a pair of reactive drones was reported over Kursk region heading to Sumy region (Source: @kpszsu/69067, @eRadarrua/101538).

Rallies in support of former defense minister Fedorov continued near Franko Square by Zelensky's office with chants against Syrsky (Source: @ukr_leaks_eng/31728, @tass_agency/385868, @DeepStateUA/23663).
VSRF are completing the liberation of Krasny Lyman with organized VSU defense broken and isolated pockets being destroyed, per Gerasimov (Source: @tass_agency/385901).
Ukraine struck two significant logistics objects in the Moscow and Tambov regions at over 500 and about 700 km from the front used for drone components (Source: @UkraineNow/82742).

sections.threat_assessment: The reported completion of VSRF operations in Krasny Lyman indicates a significant shift in eastern front control with Ukrainian defensive coherence degraded. The massive ballistic barrage on Kyiv exceeding 32 rockets from Kursk and via Lubny represents a severe escalation in strategic strike tempo against the capital. Sustained reactive drone streams from the Black Sea and northern borders expose broad Ukrainian vulnerability across Odesa, Chernihiv and Sumy. Ukrainian deep strikes on Moscow and Tambov logistics over 500 and 700 km from the front demonstrate expanded long-range reach against Russian drone supply chains.
sections.regional_response: Public rallies near Franko Square in Kyiv support former minister Fedorov and demand Syrsky's resignation, reflecting domestic pressure on military leadership amid mobilization rights violations reported by the Ombudsman. Russia's Federation Council figure Karasin promised a harsh response to VSU strikes on Wildberries logistics centers, signaling potential retaliatory targeting. The EU expressed concern over Ukrainian defense procurement programs signed by the dismissed Fedorov amid corruption safeguards. Training of new BARS counter-drone units in Russia indicates structural adaptation to persistent Ukrainian UAV threats.
sections.intelligence_notes: Open-source tracker messages show a coordinated multi-axis drone campaign with reactive UAVs from Black Sea, Bryansk, Kursk and northeast toward Odesa, Chernihiv, Sumy, Kharkiv and Vinnytsia. Ballistic threat warnings from south and from Bryansk/Kursk oblasts align with the recorded Kyiv missile influx exceeding 32 rockets. Russian claims of broken VSU defense in Krasny Lyman and DeepStateUA's noted enemy advance near Piazeno and Rodynske should be correlated via independent geolocation. Ukrainian acknowledgment of strikes on Moscow and Tambov logistics at 500 and 700 km confirms deep interdiction doctrine against drone component supply.
